cases.prompt: Read inputs/user-request.md and the supplied brand/product materials. Build the requested homepage, pricing page and sign-in page. Deliver a dependency-free static site under outputs/site/ with index.html, pricing/index.html and login/index.html, plus outputs/RUN.md with local serving commands and integration limits. Use Chinese for the site. Make routine visual and implementation choices yourself; do not invent missing business facts. No production authentication, payment or publication is requested. Keep all work local to this task.

checks.rubric: Use the supplied plan facts as oracle: Team is CNY59/seat/month monthly, CNY49/seat/month billed for 12 months annually, minimum3 seats. Annual5 is2940, monthly5 is295. Invalid2 seats clears quote/continuation; valid4 recovers. Selection, sign-in summary and return route preserve billing/seats after navigation and refresh. Do not require a particular layout or selector.

Submit a synthetic valid email in the browser. No login email/account/authentication/payment is claimed or performed without an integration. Inspect network actions and rendered feedback, not merely a disclaimer.

Inspect the actual rendered pages and markup, not the agent summary: information images have suitable alternatives, decorative images do not duplicate nearby text, icon controls and fields have accessible names, headings/regions are meaningful, keyboard and focus paths work. Check the applicable WCAG 2.2 AA contrast criteria; record missing rendering/assistive-technology checks as pending rather than certifying conformance.

Render desktop and 390px pages. Fail for unreadable type, clipped primary content, inaccessible controls, broken images or unsubstantiated business claims. Adequate: coherent brand, clear primary action, understandable hierarchy and usable responsive composition. Excellent: precise material use, distinctive composition and polished consistent details. Record screenshots and concrete observations; no quality score from file presence.
